confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Toulouse price levels, not from live menus, booking pages, or current listings. Restaurant and café anchors (beer, coffee, inexpensive meal, mid-range meal) are the most reliable. Accommodation anchors are less certain because July is peak season and Toulouse hotel rates vary with events, conferences, and rugby or football fixtures. Cocktail and wine are weaker estimates, set relative to beer prices in French brasseries and bars. Values are USD conversions of euro-denominated price levels at approximate 2026 rates, so they carry FX drift.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized French regional cities with similar tourist and student demand (Montpellier, Bordeaux, Nantes, Strasbourg) and adjusted for Toulouse's relatively moderate Paris-independent price level. Drinks are set relative to local brasserie and bar pricing; accommodation is set relative to regional French hotel and hostel tiers in summer.
